body.name: \mathfrak R
body.construction: For fixed \(s\in[1,2]\), partition every compliance-strength sequence after passage to a subsequence as follows: \(\mathfrak R_{\mathrm{flat}}=\{\tau_n\to0\}\); \(\mathfrak R_{\mathrm{slope}}=\{\tau_n\to\tau\in(0,\infty)\}\); \(\mathfrak R_{\mathrm{entropy},0}=\{\tau_n\to\infty,\lambda_n\to0\}\); \(\mathfrak R_{\mathrm{entropy},\lambda}=\{\tau_n\to\infty,\lambda_n\to\lambda\in(0,\infty)\}\); and \(\mathfrak R_{\mathrm{recovered}}=\{\tau_n\to\infty,\lambda_n\to\infty\}\). The cutoff-recovery predicate \(\mathsf{CR}(s,\kappa_\bullet)\) holds exactly when \(\lambda_n\to\infty\). The finite-grid upper-rate subregime is defined separately by \(\text{def:profile-resolution-schedule}\).
